goal: Review container image scanner findings: which are reachable, which have fixes, and which are false positives.
use: Review container image scanner findings: which are reachable, which have fixes, and which are false positives. Use when an image scan reports findings before a release.

steps.note: Read the scan output. Take the findings the user exports, with package, version and severity.
Check the base layer. Note which findings come from the base image, and whether a newer base image fixes them.
Check reachability. For each finding, decide whether the code in the image uses the vulnerable component.
Check fixes. Note the fixed version of each package and whether a rebuild with updated packages is enough.
Check false positives. Mark findings with no fix and no reachable path as candidates for a documented exception, not as passed.
Report. A table: finding, layer, reachable, fix, and decision.
